title: 2.9 STEP: An 8K-60fps Space-Time Resolution-Enhancement Neural-Network Processor for Next-Generation Display and Streaming
problem: Rendering 8K-UHD 60fps videos on edge devices requires balancing model depth for quality against resource constraints, and managing on-chip memory overhead from deformable convolution with modulation (DCM) across multiple temporal alignment layers.
motivation: Ultra-high-definition (UHD) displays demand efficient on-device video enhancement as 8K stream scarcity and transmission bandwidth costs necessitate real-time super-resolution on terminal displays.
method: The processor implements a space-time video super-resolution (STVSR) algorithm with layer-fusion (LF) workflow to reduce intermediate feature map storage, deformable convolution for temporal alignment across frames, and a PE array architecture sized for 8K-60fps throughput while minimizing power consumption.
key_novelty: Layer-fusion workflow that reduces on-chip memory overhead from deformable convolution modulation by fusing operations across multiple temporal alignment layers.
contributions: 8K-60fps space-time video super-resolution processor for edge devices
Layer-fusion technique to reduce feature map memory storage in DCM-based temporal alignment
Architecture balancing PE array throughput with power efficiency constraints
